props.title: GRAYSCALE
props.subtitle: A free, responsive one-page theme by Start Bootstrap — rebuilt here as a Tovu theme to prove design is just data.

props.title: Built with Tovu's core components.
props.lead: Every section on this page — the nav, the masthead, the feature grid, the footer — is one of a small set of reusable building blocks a theme arranges by name.
body: Grayscale is open source and MIT licensed. This adaptation keeps its bold, high-contrast spirit — a dark masthead, teal accents, generous whitespace — but every pixel here comes from theme.json, tokens.json, and a JSON template, not from compiled Sass or Pug.
Swap the palette, rearrange the sections, or hand this whole file to an AI: "make the accent warmer, move Journal above Work."
bullets: No executable code ships inside a theme
Same components as every other Tovu theme

props.title: A few ways this theme flexes.

items.title: Full-bleed & bold
items.body: A dark, uppercase, letter-spaced hero — Grayscale's signature move, reproduced with tokens instead of a photo asset.

items.title: Auto-fit cards
items.body: The same three-up grid tovu-official uses, restyled here with a teal accent and rounder type.

items.title: Real posts, real theme
items.body: The entries below are your actual published posts, rendered through this theme's own tokens and CSS.

props.title: Make it yours.
props.subtitle: Switch themes from the admin, or drop a new theme folder into your site — this whole page is a starting point you can rewrite.
